description: This file defines a React functional component called SearchBar, which provides a UI for searching cities via a geocoding API, handling user input, displaying results, and allowing selection of a city. It manages internal state for query, search results, loading, and errors, and communicates the selected location via a callback.

methods.name: SearchBar
methods.description: React functional component for city search, handling user input, API calls, and result display.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles 'Enter' key press to trigger geocoding API call and update results.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Handles selecting a search result, updating query, closing results list, and invoking callback.
